title: What Happens When Ammo Burns? Sporting Ammunition and the Fire Fighter | SAAMI.org
summary: A SAAMI-produced training video for firefighters explaining what happens when sporting ammunition burns, including that unchambered cartridges lack the energy to penetrate much. It includes test footage of ammunition in fires.
why: Cited as evidence that ammunition cooking off in a fire is much less dangerous than people assume.

quote.text: Ammo cooking off in a fire sounds dramatic but isn't particularly dangerous [0]
